notes: BS, Physics (PY29). 52 lower-division units + 57 upper-division units = 109 units total. Verified verbatim against catalog. The listed focus areas (Astrophysics, Biophysics, Computational Physics, Physics of the Earth/Oceans/Atmosphere, Materials Physics) are optional concentrations within this single BS degree, sharing this exact core and differing only in the restricted-elective pool. A separate BA, Physics (PY35) also exists: 52 lower-division + 49 upper-division = 101 units; upper core PHYS 100A-B, 110A, 120, 130A (21 units) + seven 4-unit upper-division science/engineering courses with >=12 units from upper-division/graduate physics (28 units).

buckets.label: Lower-Division Physics Core
buckets.note: PHYS 4A-B-C-D-E (20 units) + PHYS 2CL-2DL (4 units) + PHYS 41 (4 units).

buckets.label: Upper-Division Lab
buckets.note: One from PHYS 122, 124, 133, 173, or ASTR 150 (4 units).

buckets.label: Restricted Electives
buckets.note: Five upper-division and/or graduate-level courses (20 units) from PHYS 100-195 and 200-295. Choosing a focus area is optional; if chosen, up to two courses may come from outside physics per the focus-area lists.

buckets.label: Total Units for the Major
buckets.note: 52 lower-division + 57 upper-division units. Pure unit-count requirement: 109 total units for the BS Physics major (PY29) = 52 lower-division + 57 upper-division. No course list; satisfied by completing the core/electives buckets that sum to this total. Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/PHYS-ug.html.
